sentences.text: Amplibuteo was an extinct genus of raptorial birds belonging to the family Accipitridae.
The genus Amplibuteo was described by Campbell in 1979.
The genus name Amplibuteo was established by Campbell in 1979.
The type species of the genus Amplibuteo is Amplibuteo hibbardi.
Fossils of Amplibuteo date to the Pleistocene epoch.
Amplibuteo lived from the Zanclean age to the Late Pleistocene, approximately 4.7 to 0.0117 million years ago.
